faq: How do I place an order?
Open a shirt, choose colour and size, then tap Add to cart or Buy now. Login, enter your delivery address and pay online.
Can I order on WhatsApp instead?
Yes. Tap Enquire on WhatsApp on any shirt. The shirt name, price, size and link are filled in for you.
How do I choose my size?
Open the Size guide on the shirt page. It shows chest, length and shoulder in inches. If you are between two sizes, take the bigger one for a relaxed fit.
Online payment only: UPI, cards, net banking and wallets through Razorpay.
Delivery is free above Rs 1,999. Below that, Rs 70 is added at checkout.
How do I track my order?
Login and open My Orders to see each step from placed to delivered.
Yes. Open My Orders and tap Cancel order while the status is Order Placed or Confirmed.
How do I wash a shirt so it lasts?
Wash dark colours inside out in cold water, dry in shade and iron on the reverse side.
